artBrief: **Science-fiction ensemble.** A small space crew gathers around a glowing radio and book, with simple speech-bubble shapes. This is a metaphor, not a claim that the learner took group lessons.

request.description: One original collectible achievement illustration for a language-learning app, native 128x128 pixel art, opaque square environmental scene. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters, clean readable silhouettes, restrained 32-color palette. A single strong focal subject should remain identifiable at 64x64. Fill the canvas but keep the main subject within an 8-pixel safe margin. No badge frame, lettering, numbers, readable text, logos or watermarks; no photorealism, blur or smooth vector art. Science-fiction ensemble. A small space crew gathers around a glowing radio and book, with simple speech-bubble shapes. This is a metaphor, not a claim that the learner took group lessons. Three friendly small space crew members gather around one large glowing cyan radio with an open book. Simple blank speech bubbles and dark orbital backdrop, warm faces and graphic silhouettes.

style_image.usage_description: Copy only pixel cluster scale, crisp edge handling and shading discipline. Do not copy the reference scene, objects, layout or palette. Follow the new scene brief. Where a white fox is requested, preserve its pointed ears, muzzle and fluffy tail.
